notes.title: Starena V1.0.3.4 update
notes.notes:
1.The voxel weapon customize module system is upgraded, now Steam Workshop is supported
2.BossRush has added Roguelike mode, time to challenge the powerful enemies!
3.Two new commentator is online.
4.Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Starena V1.0.2.1 update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the freeze problem while playing barbell mini game
2. Optimized vibration feedback of PS4 controller
3. Fixed some problems of hidden boss
4. Added tips for free movement of visual angle in the lounge

notes.title: Starena V1.0.2.0 update
notes.notes:
1. Greatly optimized the performance of the competition, you can loot golds much happier.
2. Added vibration feedback to the controller.
3. Fixed some problems after Miaow was shot down.
4. Fixed the problem that Skysolo Barrier would blocks J3.

notes.title: V1.0.1.9 update announcement
notes.notes:
1. Optimized rendering performance, required less usage of your graphics card
2. Fixed the problem that the gyrate task cannot be completed
3. Deleted the levitation ability of Titan Bike
4. Fixed the problem that Rena's attack sometimes targets the air
5. Fixed the abnormal ranking during boss rush mode
6. Wendy won't be scared by shotgun Rena anymore
7. Add more stunning effect for Fin Funnels
8. Fixed the freezing problem caused by game pause in some cases in the battle

notes.title: Starena V1.0.1.6 update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the wrong calculating bonus of mercenary sword’s damage to items
2. Fixed the problem that the DIY Sword could not be operated after the handle AB was reversed
3. Fixed the problem that Rena's prompt was not hidden at the end of the battle
4. The camera on the lounge can be rotated freely by holding middle mouse button or by using the right joystick on your controller now
5. Optimized the special effect performance of the position mission

notes.title: Demo version updated to V0.11.2.2
notes.notes:
1. Added DX10 compatibility mode to get rid of the trouble of black screen
2. Fixed the problem of the Gatlin machine gun do not hit the boss.
3. Fixed the problem of player's blood strip disappeared in some cases
4. Weakened the throwing strength of some fans

notes.title: Demo version updated to V0.11.1.8
notes.notes:
1. Repaired an abnormal number of fans' items.
2. Repaired Mallet odd behavior after defeated him.
3. Repaired abnormal amount of blood volume of the training bot in the lounge and the training Fist. 
4. Repaired the problem of the stiff time after the mobile artillery hit the player.
5. Added anti-addiction prompting mechanism. It will pop up the anti-addiction prompting window before the platform forces the game to close now.
6. Repaired the problem of commentator strike when player fighting with mobile artillery.
